card.name: Small words before drug and dose terms
card.fires_on: Short linking words such as the, can, another, certain, or Other right after a verb or heading in drug-label text, just before a drug, dose or label-section noun. Also on a few heading words like Year and How.

modes.label: Word before dose or drug noun
modes.description: A small word like the, another or certain follows a verb such as reduce, increase, avoid or interfere with, and a drug or dose term comes next.

modes.label: Heading words in interaction sections
modes.description: The word Drugs ends a heading such as 'Other Drugs', or a short word starts a subsection heading.
modes.example: Effect of Other<< Drugs>> on Diazepam Metabolism: In

modes.label: Start of a statement
modes.description: A short word opens a statement after a heading, such as Can in a toxicity summary.
